req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a PUT request to update a non-existent task should return a 404 error. This behavior needs to be validated through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the system correctly identifies non-existent tasks and responds with the appropriate HTTP status code.

tests.name: Update existing task
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/1 with valid update payload
expected: Task is updated with new data
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

update_payload = {
    "title": "Updated Task Title",
    "description": "Updated description",
    "completed": False
}

response = client.put("/tasks/1", json=update_payload)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == "Updated Task Title"
assert response.json()["description"] == "Updated description"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: Update non-existent task
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/999 with valid update payload
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

update_payload = {
    "title": "Non-existent Task",
    "description": "This task does not exist",
    "completed": True
}

response = client.put("/tasks/999", json=update_payload)
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: Update task with boundary id
preconditions: Task with id 20 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/20 with valid update payload
expected: Task is updated with new data
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

update_payload = {
    "title": "Boundary Task Update",
    "description": "Boundary case update",
    "completed": True
}

response = client.put("/tasks/20", json=update_payload)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()["title"] == "Boundary Task Update"
assert response.json()["description"] == "Boundary case update"
assert response.json()["completed"] is True
